scripts.verify: pnpm verify:typecheck && pnpm verify:lint && pnpm verify:contracts && pnpm verify:unit && pnpm verify:integration && pnpm verify:contract-tests && pnpm verify:e2e:changed && pnpm verify:a11y:shell && pnpm verify:evals:stub && pnpm verify:security && pnpm verify:leak && pnpm verify:secrets && pnpm verify:lockfile && pnpm verify:audit
scripts.verify:lint: turbo run lint -- --max-warnings 0 && pnpm exec eslint scripts eslint.config.mjs "packages/*/scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs,ts,mts,cts}" "evals/**/*.{ts,mjs}" --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --max-warnings 0
scripts.verify:unit: turbo run test:unit -- --coverage && node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name unit:root --dir tests/unit --ext .test.ts --ext .spec.ts -- vitest run tests/unit
scripts.verify:contract-tests: node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name contract-tests --dir tests/contract --ext .test.ts --ext .spec.ts -- vitest run tests/contract
scripts.verify:e2e:changed: node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name e2e:changed --dir tests/e2e --ext .spec.ts --ext .test.ts -- playwright test tests/e2e --grep @smoke
scripts.verify:a11y:shell: node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name a11y:shell --dir tests/a11y --ext .spec.ts --ext .test.ts -- playwright test tests/a11y --grep @shell
scripts.verify:evals:stub: node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name evals:stub --file scripts/eval-guard.ts -- node scripts/eval-guard.ts --mode stub
scripts.verify:security: node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name security --dir tests/security --ext .test.ts --ext .spec.ts -- vitest run tests/security
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm verify:full:e2e && pnpm verify:e2e:journeys && pnpm verify:full:a11y && pnpm verify:full:audit && pnpm verify:full:evals
scripts.verify:full:e2e: node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name full:e2e --dir tests/e2e --ext .spec.ts --ext .test.ts -- playwright test tests/e2e
scripts.verify:e2e:journeys: node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name e2e:journeys --dir tests/e2e/journeys --ext .spec.ts -- playwright test --config tests/e2e/journeys/playwright.config.ts
scripts.verify:full:a11y: node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name full:a11y --dir tests/a11y --ext .spec.ts --ext .test.ts -- playwright test tests/a11y
scripts.verify:full:evals: node scripts/verify-stage.mjs --name full:evals --file scripts/eval-guard.ts -- node scripts/eval-guard.ts --mode stub --all
